clock_and_hypotheses.prograde_only_conclusion: no (M,chi) in pinned prograde grid absorbs 220 at V1 clock [DERIVED by c1]
clock_and_hypotheses.counter_rotating_family: 220-only can be absorbed at chi~0.10..0.22 and M/M_f~0.58..0.72 [DECLARED by c1/skeptic; not recalculated here]
clock_and_hypotheses.legacy_k1_scope: seq 58/87/91, C6 lnB~-0.0026, B2 Fisher and GW250114 proxy ~0.06 sigma; historical controls only, not V1 power

hypotheses.GR: Kerr 220 and 440, same final mass/spin, per-mode amplitudes/phases profiled
hypotheses.B_220_440: V1 local KMS clock, exact additive-rate envelope for both modes; 440 deformation is INPUT

primary_and_secondary.primary: V1 full IMR with C3; its official verdict is preserved as a separate field
primary_and_secondary.secondary: F4.3 ringdown-only; all DIAGNOSTIC_* tokens below are LOCAL, not V1 outputs
primary_and_secondary.C8: one k and one M_f per event; never credit 221 to 440

local_aliases_retired.INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS__BOTH_MODELS_RE: DIAGNOSTIC_BOTH_MODELS_REJECTED; joint reading INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS, V1 field unchanged
local_aliases_retired.UNDERPOWERED_OR_NONIDENTIFIABLE: DIAGNOSTIC_UNDERPOWERED_OR_NONIDENTIFIABLE; V1 NOT_FALSIFIED_UNDERPOWERED only if V1 itself fails its power gate
local_aliases_retired.NOT_FALSIFIED_POWERED from neither_rejec: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY__NEITHER_REJECTED; only V1 can emit official NOT_FALSIFIED_POWERED

decision_table.when: manifest incomplete or exact injected power absent
exact injected recovery below 90% at one-sided 5 sigma, or 440 not identifiable
calibration, coverage, bias, PSD, family or rcond stability fails
decision_table.joint_reading: INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS; V1 official token still recorded independently

decision_table.when: F4.3 rejects both GR and pair B under their own calibrated nulls
decision_table.joint_reading: INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS; do not choose either model

decision_table.when: powered F4.3 points opposite to V1 primary direction
decision_table.joint_reading: INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS; no joint claim; V1 official token retained in separate field

decision_table.when: powered F4.3 and V1 reject the same named null, each with calibrated one-sided p <= alpha
decision_table.joint_reading: corroboration of V1 only, never independent F4.3 credit

decision_table.when: F4.3 directional signal but V1 has no compatible powered direction

synthetic_screen.eta_joint_25: necessary median 5-sigma distance in ideal simple Gaussian shift; not 90-percent power
synthetic_screen.eta_increment_440_1: minimal relevance floor, 1-sigma incremental distance; cannot independently imply detection
synthetic_screen.rcond_rule: rank, eta screening verdict and diagnostic direction must be stable across sweep; otherwise DIAGNOSTIC_INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS
synthetic_screen.exact_required: delta_tau = -x/(1+x), full IMR V1 C3 and common M_f,chi_f for 220+440
synthetic_screen.decisive_power: calibrated >=90% recovery at one-sided 5 sigma under exact injections and null coverage; analytic screen never substitutes

power_status.reason: V2 manifest leaves final event list, per-event PSD and hashes, windows, priors, start rule, waveform family/version/hash, covariance and injection seed/repetitions null. Existing O4 strain archive and older C7 injections do not specify this F4.3 joint 220+440 experiment.
